5480.title: Codex review notifications reach diagnostic fallback
5480.rootCauseOneLine: guardianWarning is known but marked unknown and absent from the handled schema, so it becomes one raw diagnostic record per notice.
5480.proposedFix: Agree automatic-review visibility/grouping policy, then normalize validated notifications and update Codex coverage without changing permissions.
5480.caveats: Provider/assembler and timeline projection reproduced twice; no live automatic approval or browser screenshot. Chrome/Chromium unavailable; source storybook also hit an unrelated export-resolution failure. No safe PR because notice presentation/grouping needs a product decision.
